description: Capture the screen and run approved desktop actions on macOS or Windows. Use context/windows/select_window focus=false to understand and choose an app/window, click only to mark a target with the virtual AI cursor, and use type with text to enter words such as hello. For existing user Chrome, target Google Chrome instead of opening a managed profile. If type/key returns recovery.kind=chrome_setting, stop retrying and report that Chrome blocks true background control until the setting is enabled.

config.name: computer_use
config.summary: コンピューター操作。まず action=context で開いているアプリとAIカーソルを確認し、文字入力は action=type と text を優先し、既存Chrome/ChatGPTには app=Google Chrome または select_window focus=false を指定してください。Chrome設定ブロックが返ったら再試行せず理由を報告してください。

action.description: Use context/windows to inspect open apps, select_window with app/title and focus=false to target one app, click to place the virtual AI cursor/marker, type to enter text, key for shortcuts or single keys, and screenshot to inspect.

text.description: Text to enter when action is type. Prefer this over repeated key presses for words.

key.description: Single key or shortcut key for action=key, for example backspace, return, or a with modifier=meta.

modifier.description: Optional single key modifier such as meta, command, control, shift, or alt.

settings_fields.help: Default desktop target for new tasks; request-specific details are supplied at call time.

settings_fields.help: Preferred operating mode before issuing desktop actions.

settings_fields.help: Durable safety preference for desktop operations.
